title: ReleaseManifest
description: Release manifest for the reproducible private delivery (API-09 / OPS-01). A release ships the manifest, not source code: images are referenced by digest, so the same manifest reproduces the release on any installation without a rebuild.

git_sha.description: Full SHA of the released commit (never a branch or tag name).

image_digests.description: Digests of the built artifacts pushed to the private registry. Build once; every environment deploys these exact digests.

base_digests.description: Verified upstream base-image digests used by the build (python, node, nginx, postgres, redis, registry).

migration_head.description: Alembic revision at the head of the released migration chain.

locks.description: Concurrency facts of the release: the advisory-lock id of the one-shot migration and the serialization policy.

serialization.const: one-shot migrate holds a pg advisory lock; concurrent releases serialize; a failed migration blocks the version switch

licenses.description: Licenses of shipped third-party resources (fonts, images, libraries) referenced by the release.

runner_digest.description: Exact verified digest of the self-hosted CI runner image used to execute the release pipeline.

contract_versions.description: Versions of the contracts the release was built against.

forms.description: Form manifests shipped with the release (INPUT-04): id, version, template sha256, official flag.
